title: OpenPlanr planning artifacts
summary: What the skills write under .planr/ in your repository, and where the deterministic planr CLI validates those files and keeps your tracker in step.

nodes.label: spec
nodes.description: Shapes intent into a measurable specification, asking only the questions that change the outcome.

nodes.label: plan
nodes.description: Decomposes the specification into user stories and tasks. It never starts implementation on its own.

nodes.description: Implements one task with the plan read first, verifies it, and records the result.

accessibility.title: OpenPlanr planning artifacts
accessibility.description: The spec, plan, and ship skills run inside your coding agent. Spec writes the specification, plan writes the user stories and tasks that ship reads before it changes code, and ship appends each shipped task to the provenance log. All of them live under .planr/ in your repository, written by the agent and reviewed like code. The planr CLI validates those files offline, never by a model, and keeps GitHub Issues or Linear in step.
